events.label: Наука
entries: 1800 – David Thompson reaches the mouth of the Saskatchewan River in Manitoba.
1938 – The Douglas DC-4E makes its first test flight.
1981 – The Israeli Air Force destroys Iraq's Osiraq nuclear reactor during Operation Opera.
1991 – Mount Pinatubo erupts, generating an ash column 7 kilometres (4.3 mi) high.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1962 – The Organisation Armée Secrète (OAS) sets fire to the University of Algiers library building, destroying about 500,000 books.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1810 – The newspaper Gazeta de Buenos Ayres is first published in Argentina.
1977 – Five hundred million people watch the high day of the Silver Jubilee of Queen Elizabeth II begin on television.
1982 – Priscilla Presley opens Graceland to the public; the bathroom where Elvis Presley died five years earlier is kept off-limits.
